提携・ライセンス・買収・協業

relations.text: ASEは、パッケージング装置をLam Research Corporationなどの大手メーカーから購入している
relations.text_en: ASE purchases packaging equipment from major international manufacturers, including Lam Research Corporation

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: We purchase our packaging equipment from major international manufacturers, including All Ring Tech Co., Ltd., Marketech lnternational Corp., Grand Process Technology Corporation, Tokyo Electron Limited, and Lam Research Corporation.

relations.text: ASEは、テスターを主にTeradyne, Inc.、Tokyo Electron Limited、Advantest Corporationから購入している
relations.text_en: ASE purchases testers primarily from Teradyne, Inc., Tokyo Electron Limited and Advantest Corporation

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: We purchase testers from major international manufacturers, primarily Teradyne, Inc., Tokyo Electron Limited, and Advantest Corporation.

companies.name: ラティス・セミコンダクター
companies.sub: プログラマブル半導体

relations.text: LatticeのForm 10-Kが、ASEとAmkorを認定済みの主要な組立パートナー2社として挙げている
relations.text_en: Lattice's 10-K says it has qualified two major assembly partners, ASE and Amkor

source.label: Lattice Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: We have qualified two major assembly partners, ASE and Amkor Technology ("Amkor") and are second sourced where volume and customer requirements make it necessary.

relations.text: Latticeのウェハーソートテストは、主にASEが台湾とマレーシアで行っている
relations.text_en: Lattice's wafer sort testing is primarily performed by ASE in Taiwan and Malaysia

source.label: Lattice Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: Wafer sort testing is primarily performed by ASE in Taiwan and Malaysia, and by our second source King Yuan Electronics Company (“KYEC”) in Taiwan.

relations.text: Ambarellaは、Samsungから購入したテスト済みダイの組立をASEに委託している
relations.text_en: Ambarella contracts the assembly of tested die purchased from Samsung to ASE

source.label: Ambarella 10-K
source.quote: In the case of purchases of tested die from Samsung, we contract the assembly to Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc., or ASE.

companies.name: クレド・セミコンダクター

relations.text: Credoは、IC製品の組立・テストの大部分を、Amkor、ASE、KYEC、Sigurdなどの外部製造委託先に任せている
relations.text_en: Credo uses third-party contract manufacturers, including Amkor, ASE, KYEC and Sigurd, for a significant majority of its assembly and test operations for IC products

source.label: Credo 10-K
source.quote: We also use third-party contract manufacturers for a significant majority of our assembly and test operations, including Amkor, ASE, KYEC and Sigurd for our IC products, and BizLink for our AEC products.

companies.name: インディ・セミコンダクター

relations.text: indie Semiconductorは、ASEなどでパッケージングを複数社に分けて調達している
relations.text_en: indie Semiconductor multi-sources packaging at ASE and other suppliers

source.label: indie Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: We multi-source packaging at ASE, SCK, and other suppliers.

relations.text: MaxLinearは、ASEを最大級の製造パートナー4社の1社に挙げている
relations.text_en: MaxLinear names ASE among four of its largest manufacturing partners

source.label: MaxLinear 10-K
source.quote: For example, according to their websites, four of our largest manufacturing partners, ASE, Intel, TSMC, and UMC, each maintain well-developed environmental management and sustainability programs that are publicly avowed and supported by the highest levels of

relations.text: SiTimeは、組立・テストを主にASE、Carsem、UTACに頼っている
relations.text_en: SiTime primarily relies on ASE, Carsem and UTAC for assembly and testing

source.label: SiTime 10-K
source.quote: We currently primarily rely on ASE, Carsem, and UTAC for assembly and testing, as well as Daishinku, UTAC, Hana Semiconductor (Ayutthaya) Co., Ltd, and ASE for ceramic packaging for some of our products.

relations.text: ASEは、TSMCとの戦略的提携と地理的な近さにより、ファウンドリ・サービスを含む総合的な製造ソリューションを提供できると説明している
relations.text_en: ASE says its strategic alliance with and proximity to TSMC lets it offer a total semiconductor manufacturing solution that includes foundry services

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: Through our strategic alliance with and close geographic proximity to TSMC, we are able to offer our customers a total semiconductor manufacturing solution that includes access to foundry services in addition to our packaging, testing, and direct shipment services.

relations.text: ASEは1997年からTSMCと戦略的提携を結び、TSMCから製造半導体の非独占的な優先パッケージング・テスト提供者に指定されている
relations.text_en: Since 1997 ASE has had a strategic alliance with TSMC, which designates it a non-exclusive preferred provider of packaging and testing services for TSMC-made semiconductors

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: Since 1997, we have maintained a strategic alliance with TSMC, which designates us as their non-exclusive preferred provider of packaging and testing services for semiconductors manufactured by TSMC.

companies.name: アナログ・デバイセズ

relations.text: ASE Malaysiaの取締役会が2026年3月に、Analog Devicesのマレーシアの製造子会社の取得を決議した
relations.text_en: In March 2026 the board of ASE Malaysia resolved to acquire Analog Devices's manufacturing subsidiaries in Malaysia

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: and South Korea to expand power chip module packaging and testing and lead frame packaging, and in March 2026, the board of directors of ASE Malaysia resolved to acquire Analog Devices’s manufacturing subsidiaries in Malaysia to enhance supply chain resilience and manufacturing diversity.
source.note: 取得決議の段階の記載です。
source.note_en: Describes a board resolution to acquire.

relations.text: ASEは、TDK Corporationなどと非独占の技術ライセンス契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: ASE has entered into non-exclusive technology license agreements with companies including TDK Corporation

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: We have also entered into various non-exclusive technology license agreements with other companies involved in the semiconductor manufacturing process, including Infineon Technologies AG, TDK Corporation, and DECA Technologies Inc.

relations.text: TDKとのライセンス契約は、許諾された特許が満了するまで有効である
relations.text_en: The license agreement with TDK remains in effect until expiration of the licensed patents

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: Our license agreements with TDK Corporation and DECA remain in effect until expiration of their respective patents licensed by the agreements.

relations.text: ASEは、NXPとの合弁会社ASENの60%を取得した
relations.text_en: ASE acquired 60% of ASEN, its joint venture with NXP Semiconductors

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F

relations.text: ASEのVIPackプラットフォーム向けに、SiemensのInnovator3D ICを用いた3Dblox対応ワークフローを開発している
relations.text_en: Siemens works with ASE to develop 3Dblox-based workflows for the ASE VIPack platform using Siemens' Innovator3D IC solution

source.label: Siemens — ASE VIPack / 3Dblox collaboration, September 25, 2025
source.quote: (ASE), the leading global provider of semiconductor manufacturing services in assembly and test, to develop 3Dblox-based workflows for the ASE VIPack™ platform using Siemens’ Innovator3D IC™ solution, which is fully certified for the 3Dblox standard..

relations.text: SiemensとASEが3Dbloxワークフローで協業している
relations.text_en: Siemens and ASE collaborate on 3Dblox workflows

source.label: Siemens — ASE VIPack / 3Dblox collaboration, September 25, 2025
source.quote: Siemens & ASE collaborate on 3Dblox workflows | Siemens

companies.name: アムコー・テクノロジー

relations.text: アムコー・テクノロジーの年次報告が、ASEテクノロジーを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names ASE Technology as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Amkor Technology 10-K
source.quote: We face competition from established packaging and test service providers primarily located in Asia, including ASE Technology, JCET Group and Powertech Technology.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
